source_locator: Statement of Votes Cast, MAYOR, page 12 of 138, Total row (Total all voting types, jurisdiction wide)
verification_note: Official Baltimore City Board of Elections Statement of Votes Cast, general election held November 8, 2011 (report dated 11/22/11). Rawlings-Blake (DEM) 40,125; Griffin (REP) 6,108; write-ins 1,270. Sum 47,503 equals the stated total votes. The Internet Archive copy of the same PDF (captured 2025-10-27) is the same file size as the current board file. The Maryland State Archives Manual page shows lower figures (39,548 / 6,022 / 1,244); the official board document is used.
total_votes_basis: sum of all mayoral candidates plus write-ins, citywide, polling plus absentee/provisional plus early voting

source_locator: Jurisdiction Wide Summary (Report EL45, OFFICIAL RESULTS), Mayor contest, Total row
verification_note: Official Baltimore City Board of Elections summary report for November 5, 2024 (run date 12/12/24, 295 of 295 precincts). Scott (DEM) 179,732; Wright (REP) 36,484; write-ins 2,574. Total 218,790 equals the sum. Report EL45A gives the same totals by voting method. The Maryland State Archives Manual page shows lower figures (156,355 / 32,324 / 2,277); the official board document is used.
total_votes_basis: sum of all mayoral candidates plus write-ins, citywide; excludes 83 over votes and 14,254 under votes
